notes: These identifiers were supplied by the ORBIS project owner.
The App ID and Ad Unit ID are different identifiers and must be used in their corresponding native Android SDK settings.
This file only records configuration; it does not activate ads.
The current ORBIS web page and Telegram Mini App do not become AdMob-enabled by adding these IDs. Web and Mini App advertising require a separately supported integration.
Before release, verify the ad format, placement, app registration, consent/privacy requirements, and test ads in the Google AdMob console.
